Well, let me think about this year like I do every year. I've been on this land for forty years, so I know what my fields can do.

My 10.1 mu isn't all the same. I keep about 3 mu in cotton over on the west piece — that soil is a bit sandier and cotton does alright there. The other 7.1 mu I run wheat and maize back-to-back, like most folks around here. That's the main business. The cotton is extra income, but honestly with just me and my wife at home, picking cotton wears us out. I've thought about dropping it, but the price was okay last year so I'm keeping it one more year.

**Wheat** — I already planted in mid-October last fall, drilled in with the neighbor's seeder after I paid him 20 yuan per mu. Used Jimai variety seed I bought at the agricultural supply store, about 15 kg/mu. Before planting I spread compound fertilizer, 15-15-15, about 50 kg/mu. The extension man said I could use less, but I've always done it this way and the wheat comes up thick. Come March-April when it's jointing, I'll topdress urea, maybe 15 kg/mu — if it looks yellow I'll add more, if it's dark green I won't waste the money. I'll irrigate 3-4 times through the season: once in spring to green it up, once at jointing, once at heading, maybe one more at grain fill if it's dry. Each irrigation costs me about 25-30 yuan per mu in electricity for the well. I'm hoping for around 450 kg/mu; last year I got 470 but the year before only 400 because of that late frost.

**Maize** — After wheat comes off in mid-June I've got to move fast. The window is tight, maybe 5 days. I no-till plant directly into the wheat stubble — saves time and diesel, and the stubble holds moisture. Dunhuang hybrid seed, about 2.5 kg/mu, costs me around 50 yuan per mu now, gets dearer every year. At planting I drop compound fertilizer in the row with the seed, about 30 kg/mu. Then around big trumpet stage in late July I topdress urea, maybe 20 kg/mu. If the summer rains are good I might only irrigate once; if it's a dry year like 2024, twice. Hoping for 500 kg/mu — last year I hit 520 which was a good year.

**Cotton** — This is the fussy one. Plant in mid-to-late April after the soil warms up, use hybrid seed, about 1 kg/mu. Before planting I spread compound fertilizer, maybe 40 kg/mu, and work it in. During the season I topdress once or twice with urea, maybe 10-15 kg/mu total. Cotton needs spraying — I'll spray for aphids early, then for bollworms and mirids through summer, probably 6-8 sprays total. That adds up, cotton pesticide runs me around 120-150 yuan per mu. Irrigate twice, maybe three times if July-August is dry. The picking starts in September and goes into October, and that's where my wife and I spend most of our time — we don't hire help, can't afford it. Hoping for around 250 kg/mu of seed cotton, which gives about 90 kg lint after ginning.

I try to keep some cash in reserve — never spend everything on inputs. If something goes wrong mid-season, I need to be able to cover it. My total budget for inputs this year is around 5,000 yuan, and I'll stick close to that.
